BiblicalUsage: Patsal means to peel, to strip off in strips. Jacob takes rods of green poplar and peels white strakes in them in Genesis 30:37, and sets the peeled rods before the flocks in Genesis 30:38.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jacob's peeled rods are the picture of a man working with what he has, and God prospers the work of hands that do not wait for better tools.
